name: BlackCraft Cult

prices.note: Union of the TEES nav collection (/collections/tee) and /collections/blackcraft-2-0: 27 short-sleeve tees, 26 at regular price (Summoned From Salem T-Shirt excluded: 'Clearance' tag; no compare-at prices). Almost all $35; three at $31.99 ($33.99 in the largest sizes); Welcome To Hell Tee $40. Tags 'salem'/'Salem Apparel' are a collection name, not a sale.

notes: Homepage meta: 'Rooted in kindness, gratitude, and positivity, Blackcraft offers bold apparel, shoes, bags, hats, and accessories for women and men.' known_for built from it.
About: 'Spawned out of a Southern California attic' in the summer of 2012; founders Jim Somers and Bobby Schubenski; 'you don't need God or any organized belief system in order to be a good person'.
hq_country US: privacy policy contact address 'Blackcraft Cult, 572 Cross Creek Rd, Avella PA 15312, United States'.

Tee descriptions: 'classic fit short sleeve tee made with 100% ring-spun cotton', unisex fit; artwork such as Witch City Salem, Lovers Tarot Card, Power Of The Goat. Named regular-price tees: Welcome To Hell Tee ($40), Salem 400 Tee ($35), Lovers Tarot Card T-Shirt ($35).

Shipping: the shipping-policy body is empty; the site banner reads 'Enjoy FREE domestic shipping when you spend $125+ on your order!'. USD store (cart.js) with a US business address, so ships_to US; other countries not stated.
Returns: '30-day return policy' from receipt; request by email first; sale items and gift cards can't be returned; refunds to the original payment method. EU orders 14 days.
size_range detail: tees S–3XL (4XL on 3 of 27, 5XL on 2).
/pages/faq redirects to the homepage; a WebFetch of it returned HTTP 429 (not retried).
